blocks.text: You can add departments in the Zscaler Admin Console and assign the specific department to users. A user can belong to only one department.You can manually add each department or upload a CSV file that contains a list of departments.

blocks.item: From the navigation menu, go to Administration > Authentication > Departments.
Click Add Department.
See image.
The Add Department drawer appears.
In the Add Department drawer:
Department Name: Enter a department name.
Description: Optionally, enter additional notes or information. The content cannot exceed 10,240 characters.
See image.
Click Save and activate the change.

blocks.text: After creating the department, you can add users to it.
You can import up to 1,000 departments using a CSV file. If you want to add multiple users to an existing department or change the department for multiple users, use the sample CSV file template.
To import new departments or modify existing departments, using a CSV file:

blocks.item: Go to Administration > Authentication > Departments.
Click Import CSV.
See image.
The Import Department window appears.
In the Import Department window, click Download Sample to download a sample CSV template.
See image.
Enter the department details in the CSV file.
When you have the CSV file in the correct format, in the Import Department window, click Browse File.
Locate the CSV file in your local folder, then click Open.
Click Override Existing Entries if you want to replace the existing list of departments with those specified in the CSV file.
Click Import.
After the CSV file is successfully imported, the Import Department window appears, showing the total number of records that are added.
See image.
Check the details, then click Close.
The newly added departments are displayed on the Departments page.
